## Review workflow

What task is difficult today? Describe the user need rather than only an implementation.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the interaction and expected outcome. Use synthetic examples or sketches.

## Alternatives

What workaround do you use, and which alternatives did you consider?

## Scope and tradeoffs

Would this introduce Git/file writes, more retained content, new workers, platform dependencies or new navigation/draft behavior? If unknown, say so.

## Checks
